subject: dsa
title: Burst Balloons
summary: Pad both ends with 1, then let dp[i][j] be the best coins from bursting every balloon strictly between padded indices i and j. For each range, try every balloon as the LAST one burst, so its neighbours are the borders i and j.
problem: Burst all balloons for maximum coins; bursting balloon k earns left*k*right of its current neighbours. Pad both ends with 1 to get the padded array [1,3,5,1] at indices 0,1,2,3. dp[i][j] is the best coins from bursting every balloon strictly between padded indices i and j.

steps.caption: Pad the ends with 1 to get [1,3,5,1]. dp[i][j] is the best coins from bursting everything between padded indices i and j.
The trick is to pick the LAST balloon burst in a range, so its neighbours are the borders i and j. Solve the smallest ranges first.
One-balloon ranges: dp[0][2] bursts 3 last for 1*3*5 = 15, and dp[1][3] bursts 5 last for 3*5*1 = 15.
Full range dp[0][3]: bursting 3 last gives 1*3*1 + dp[1][3] = 18; bursting 5 last gives 1*5*1 + dp[0][2] = 20. Keep 20.
dp[0][3] = 20, so bursting [3,5] in the best order earns 20 coins.
